title: The Seed Swap With Missing Names
central_conflict: gardeners brought home seed packets belonging to entirely different families
decisive_choice: the registration team had switched the detachable claim slips between neighboring trays
resolution: matched signed receipts to tray numbers and returned each packet to its owner
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered gardeners brought home seed packets belonging to entirely different families during a power outage, leaving the community helpers waiting.
Rabbit tried to isolate the problem first, but they sorted the packets by color but the owners were still mismatched; fox stopped the attempt before further damage.
Fox compared the failed attempt with the evidence and realized the registration team had switched the detachable claim slips between neighboring trays; they planned a safer joint response.

With the community helpers watching, they matched signed receipts to tray numbers and returned each packet to its owner, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
